name: Heavy lift, transport and temporary works
principle: Heavy lift and transport engineering plans how very large loads are lifted, rolled or floated into position: engineered rigging, crane or gantry selection, ground bearing assessments, SPMT trailer configurations, transport surveys and lifts supervised by independent checking engineers. Temporary works — cradle supports, lifting frames, hauling systems, shoring — are designed, certified and inspected like permanent structures. Success is almost entirely preparation: surveys, simulations and rehearsals before the load moves.

process_steps.name: Route and lift-site surveys, ground bearing and clearance checks
Lift plan: crane or gantry, rigging, load path and contingency
Temporary works designed, certified and inspected
Transport and lift executed with weather and hold points

limitations: single-point lifts concentrate enormous risk in one engineered day — hold points and abort criteria are mandatory
ground bearing under cranes and SPMTs is the most common near-miss source
advantages: makes factory-built modules practical at multi-thousand-tonne scale
shutdown durations shrink when big items lift out and in as one piece
